issue.title: Bead completion offers nothing outside agent shells: catalog_sdd resolves only legacy sdd/beads, not the sidecar store, and ignores project
issue.description:
Found by the sase-17x.13.10 land agent during the live `:` Command Line walkthrough on
master 7cb835953. In a real `sase tui` (launched with `sase screenshot`, so without the
agent-only `SASE_SDD_BEADS_DIR` env var), typing `bead show ` and pressing Tab shows
`no bead`: the bead value slot offers nothing even though the project's bead store holds
thousands of beads.

Root cause: `_resolve_beads_dir()` in `src/sase/completion/candidates/catalog_sdd.py`
(used by `bead_candidates` and `bead_source_path`) only honors `SASE_SDD_BEADS_DIR` and
otherwise walks up from the process cwd looking for the legacy `sdd/beads` or
`.sase/sdd/beads` layouts. Current projects keep beads in the `sase/repos/beads`
sidecar clone, so the walk finds nothing and returns `None`, and the provider returns
`[]`. `bead_candidates(_project)` also ignores its `project` argument, so the TUI (whose
process cwd need not be inside the project) cannot resolve the store for the active
project even with a correct resolver. `plan_candidates` hand-builds the same legacy
`sdd/plans` walk (it only finds `~/.sase/plans` plus legacy repo roots). This violates
the bead-store convention: never hand-build `sdd/...` paths; resolve the effective
store the way `sase bead` does (`sase.bead.cli_location.resolve_beads_location`, which
resolves the sidecar in about 40 ms).

Secondary effect: the providers' disk cache keys `project=None` results as plain `bead`
with no cwd component, so an empty result written by one process (shell completion in a
non-project dir, or the TUI) is served to every other `project=None` caller for the TTL.

Fix sketch: resolve the bead store with `resolve_beads_location(cwd=<project workspace>,
require_existing=True)`, using the requested project's workspace when `project` is
given (as `builtins._resolve_project_checkout` does for `cd +project`) and the cwd
otherwise. Keep the `SASE_SDD_BEADS_DIR` override. Resolve plan roots the same way, and
key the disk cache by the resolved store rather than a bare `project=None`. Consider the
Rust core boundary: shell, LSP and TUI completion all need this to match.

task_type_fields.impact: Every user-facing bead slot in the TUI : Command Line (bead show/close/update ...) and shell completion outside agent shells offers no bead IDs; plan slots miss sidecar plans. Agents never notice because their env sets SASE_SDD_BEADS_DIR.
task_type_fields.repro: env -u SASE_SDD_BEADS_DIR -u SASE_SDD_PLANS_DIR -u SASE_SDD_DIR .venv/bin/python -c 'from sase.completion.candidates.catalog_sdd import _resolve_beads_dir, bead_candidates; print(_resolve_beads_dir(), len(bead_candidates(None)))' prints 'None 0' from a sase workspace, while sase.bead.cli_location.find_beads_location() resolves sase/repos/beads. Live: in sase tui press ':' then type 'bead show ' and Tab; the popup reads 'no bead'.
